<a id="verdant-visuals"></a>

### Verdant Sanctum visuals

**In progress.** The game draws Verdant itself at load from a stage art recipe (src/presentation/stage-art): a key light, an atmosphere, colour ramps and layers of shared strokes (foliage, trunks, ruined arcades, water, light), painted in short slices into layers the scene renderer composes. The painted image package is gone. Any biome reaches the same look with a recipe; Pale Traverse is next. Boss warnings and strikes on Verdant are drawn as roots and thorns rising from the floor, from a table on the stage's presentation definition that any biome can supply. The stage also moves, from a `live` list in the same recipe: water rows that ripple and glint, drifting pollen, vines that sway and light shafts that fade in and out, all bounded by limits and by a measured ceiling in config/stage-readability.json, and all held still by reduced motion and low graphics.

- Next: The owner judges the moving stage; then Pale Traverse from a recipe, with its own live list.
- Owner action: Judge the drawn look against the reference illustration: the owner's taste decides visual work.
- Evidence: [docs/BACKGROUND_WORKFLOW.md](BACKGROUND_WORKFLOW.md), [tests/unit/stage-art.test.ts](../tests/unit/stage-art.test.ts), [tests/unit/stage-live.test.ts](../tests/unit/stage-live.test.ts), [tests/unit/scene-library.test.ts](../tests/unit/scene-library.test.ts), [tests/unit/boss-tell-skin.test.ts](../tests/unit/boss-tell-skin.test.ts), [plans/active/TEAR_THE_VERDANT_SANCTUM_FULL_BIOME_PLAN_REVISION_3.md](../plans/active/TEAR_THE_VERDANT_SANCTUM_FULL_BIOME_PLAN_REVISION_3.md)

<a id="verdant-gameplay"></a>

### Verdant Sanctum gameplay

**In progress: slice 1 of 7 (the two rules) in review.** The owner rejected the Verdant gameplay a third time on 2026-11-20: the shared Verdant base is slop, move visuals linger after the move, and Verdant leans on tells far more than any other boss. Verdant's boss, enemies and stage are rebuilt from scratch in the pattern of Aldric, the Echo and the Colossus, keeping only the approved Rootbound seed-pod figure and the drawn background. Measured on main 6fb1a7cd: a scripted player takes 2.8, 1.1 and 0 hits per 10 s from today's Rootbound across its three phases, against 4 to 7 from the reference bosses; its Phase III does not move; its two phase cinematics block 12.9 s of a 37 s fight; it draws 16 tell marks against Aldric's 6. The plan adds two rules over every boss and enemy (nothing outlives its move, tell weight) and builds the new Verdant on the engineering channel until the owner approves it on preview.

- Next: Slice 1 merges: every boss and enemy is held to the two rules, with Rootbound, White Hart and Rimehound exempt until rebuilt. Then slice 2, the new Rootbound Phase I on the engineering channel.

<a id="pale-traverse"></a>

### Pale Traverse rework

**In progress.** Pale Traverse stays a Playground preview and is not published. Its gameplay is being rebuilt the way Verdant's was. The audit found that the Aurora Tracks touch nobody standing on a platform or the floor, the White Hart gives no warning the game can check and plays the same fight on every seed, and none of Pale uses the shared layers. The plan is eight pull requests: the tracks, the Rimehound, routes in the boss move layer, the White Hart one phase at a time, the waves, then leftovers. The earlier work on the unmerged branch codex/pale-traverse-r4 is reference only.

- Next: Waits for the Verdant rebuild: Pale is replanned on what Verdant proves (plans/active/VERDANT_PALE_REBUILD.md).

<a id="playtest-tool"></a>

### Playtest tool

**Stage 2 under way: stage 1 is done (pnpm playtest bosses and sweep); pnpm playtest waves opens any Adventure wave directly, runs plays whole runs from wave 1, enemies meets each enemy kind alone, coverage lists what the game defines that no report brought into play, and --compare prints what changed against another commit.** One command, pnpm playtest, that plays the game headless with scripted players on fixed seeds and reports clear rates, time to kill, damage taken and differences between builds. It is built from the working parts of TearBench and the scripted player and replaces both names. Verified on 2026-11-16: the scripted player runs headless at 13 to 15 times real time and the same seed reproduces exactly.

- Next: Stage 2's last item (every boss phase, wave and enemy kind as a row that starts directly), then stage 3: a stronger player.

### Replays

**In progress: PRs 1 to 4 merged (hidden replay features, replay extras and REPAIR removed; snapshot codecs in src/gameplay/snapshot; the detached world in src/app/world/detached); PR 5a open (the record, recorder and verify, with the round-trip check over the determinism corpus).** Players reach two replay systems today: Ghost 2 (position samples in localStorage, used by the REPLAYS tab, the feed and leaderboard links) and the Ghost V3 capsules (re-simulated, in IndexedDB, used by VAULT, CAREER and the Theater). <a id="cinematics"></a>

### Cinematics

**PRs 1-3 merged (a rule over every boss fight; no boss event slows time; the Warden, the Colossus and Aldric change phase in the fight). The intro-clock slice (the arrival counts simulation ticks) in review. The owner approved the look board (2026-11-21).** Boss phase changes stop the fight today: a ritual script freezes the combat step, locks the player and waits for a tap or a reading timeout (5.1-6.8 s each; the Source descent 11.5 s; Rootbound stands still for 12.9 s of a 32-37 s fight). Chapter openings take 25-39 s at Full. The plan makes every in-fight beat a boss move with at most a banner, cuts chapter openings and the finale to short cards that never wait, replaces the cinematic director and ritual layer with one stage beat, and adds a rule over every boss that no tick blocks input or the combat step.

- Next: Merge the intro-clock slice, then PR 4 (the Source) takes out its rituals; then PR 5 deletes the blocking path. The banner, chapter card and epilogue (PRs 6-8) follow the approved look board.
- Owner action: Play Aldric on the preview once PR 3 is there and say how the crownfall and revive feel.
